G4151.def:
**πνεῦμα**, -τος, τό,
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for רוּחַ ;]
1. **of air in motion**;
(a) **wind**: [[Jhn.3.8|Jhn.3:8]] pl., [[Heb.1.7|Heb.1:7]] (LXX);
(b) **breath**: π. ζωῆς, [[Rev.11.11|Rev.11:11]] π. τοῦ στόματος, figuratively, [[2Th.2.8|2Th.2:8]] (cf. Ps 32 (33)6).
2. Of the vital principle, **the spirit** (Arist., Polyb., al.): [[Luk.8.55|Luk.8:55]], [[Jhn.19.30|Jhn.19:30]], [[Act.7.59|Act.7:59]], al.; opposite to σάρξ, [[Mat.26.41|Mat.26:41]], [[Mrk.14.38|Mrk.14:38]], [[1Co.5.5|1Co.5:5]], al.; to σῶμα, [[Rom.8.10|Rom.8:10]], [[1Co.6.17; 7.34|1Co.6:17 7:34]], [[1Pe.4.6|1Pe.4:6]]; to ψυχή, [[Php.1.27|Php.1:27]], [[Heb.4.12|Heb.4:12]]; τὸ π. καὶ ἡ ψ. καὶ τ. σῶμα, [[1Th.5.23|1Th.5:23]] (M, _Th._, in l.); dative, τῷ π., **in spirit**, [[Mrk.2.8; 8.12|Mrk.2:8 8:12]], [[Jhn.11.33; 13.21|Jhn.11:33 13:21]], [[Act.18.25|Act.18:25]], [[Rom.12.11|Rom.12:11]], [[1Co.7.34|1Co.7:34]], [[1Pe.3.18|1Pe.3:18]], al.; of the human spirit of Christ, [[Rom.1.4|Rom.1:4]], [[1Ti.3.16|1Ti.3:16]].
3. **spirit**, i.e. frame of mind, **disposition, influence**: [[Luk.1.17|Luk.1:17]], [[Rom.8.15|Rom.8:15]], [[1Co.4.21|1Co.4:21]], [[Gal.6.1|Gal 6:1]], [[Eph.2.2|Eph.2:2]], [[2Ti.1.7|2Ti.1:7]], [[1Jn.4.6|1Jn.4:6]], al.
4. An incorporeal being, **a spirit**: [[Luk.24.37, 39|Luk.24:37, 39]] [[Act.23.8|Act.23:8]]; π. ὁ θεός, **God is spirit**, [[Jhn.4.24|Jhn.4:24]] πατὴρ τῶν π., [[Heb.12.9|Heb.12:9]] of disembodied human beings, [[Heb.12.23|Heb.12:23]], [[1Pe.3.19|1Pe.3:19]] (_ICC_, in l.; _DB_, iii, 795); of angels. [[Heb.1.14|Heb.1:14]] of demons or evil spirits, [[Mat.8.16|Mat.8:16]], [[Mrk.9.20|Mrk.9:20]], [[Luk.9.39|Luk.9:39]], al.; π. πύθυωνα, [[Act.16.16|Act.16:16]] πνεύματα δαιμονίων, [[Rev.16.14|Rev.16:14]] π. δαιμονίου ἀκαθάρτου, [[Luk.4.33|Luk.4:33]] π. ἀσθενείας (Bl., §35, 5), [[Luk.13.11|Luk.13:11]] π. ἀκάθαρτον, [[Mat.10.1|Mat.10:1]], [[Mrk.1.23|Mrk.1:23]], [[Luk.4.36|Luk.4:36]], [[Act.5.16|Act.5:16]]; π. ἄλαλον (καὶ κωφόν), [[Mrk.9.17, 25|Mrk.9:17, 25]]; πονηρόν, [[Luk.7.21|Luk.7:21]], [[Act.19.12|Act.19:12]], al.
5. Of the **Holy Spirit**, π. ἅγιον, τὸ ἅ. π., τὸ π. τὸ ἅ. τὸ π., π. (the article as a rule being used when the Spirit is regarded as a Person or a Divine Power, and omitted when the reference is to an operation, influence or gift of the Spirit; see WM, 151:5; Bl., §46, 7): anarth., [[Mat.1.18; 3.11|Mat.1:18 3:11]], 16 4:1, [[Mrk.1.8|Mrk.1:8]] (Swete, in l.), ib.10, [[Luk.1.15|Luk.1:15]], [[Jhn.7.39|Jhn.7:39]], [[Act.19.2|Act.19:2]], [[Rom.5.5|Rom.5:5]], [[1Co.2.4|1Co.2:4]], al.; with art., [[Mat.4.1; 12.31, 32|Mat.4:1 12:31, 32]] [[Mrk.1.10; 3.29|Mrk.1:10 3:29]], [[Luk.2.26|Luk.2:26]], [[Jhn.7.36; 14.26|Jhn.7:36 14:26]], [[Act.4.31; 5.3|Act.4:31 5:3]], [[Rom.8.16|Rom.8:16]], al.; (τὸ) π. (τοῦ) θεοῦ, [[Mat.3.16|Mat.3:16]], [[Rom.8.9|Rom.8:9]], [[Eph.3.16|Eph.3:16]], [[1Jn.4.2|1Jn.4:2]], al.; τὸ π. τ. πατρός, [[Mat.10.20|Mat.10:20]] π. θεοῦ ζῶντος, [[2Co.3.3|2Co.3:3]] (τὸ) π. τοῦ κυρίου, [[Luk.4.18|Luk.4:18]], [[Act.5.9; 8.39|Act.5:9 8:39]]; τὸ π. Ἰησοῦ, [[Act.16.7|Act.16:7]] Χριστοῦ, [[Rom.8.9|Rom.8:9]] Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, [[Php.1.19|Php.1:19]] τὸ π. τ. ἀληθείας, [[Jhn.15.26; 16.13|Jhn.15:26 16:13]], [[1Jn.4.6|1Jn.4:6]] λείγει (μαρτυρεῖ) τὸ π. (τὸ ἅγιον), [[Act.21.11; 28.25|Act.21:11 28:25]], [[1Ti.4.1|1Ti.4:1]], [[Heb.3.7; 10.15|Heb.3:7 10:15]], [[Rev.14.13|Rev.14:13]]; before τ. ἐκκλησίαις, [[Rev.2.7, 11|Rev.2:7, 11]] 17, 29, 3:6, 12, 22; ἐν τ. π., [[Luk.2.27|Luk.2:27]] κατὰ πνεῦμα, [[Rom.8.4|Rom.8:4]], 5; ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ π., [[Jhn.3.5|Jhn.3:5]], διὰ πνεύματος αἰωνίου, [[Heb.9.14|Heb.9:14]] ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος, [[2Th.2.13|2Th.2:13]], [[1Pe.1.2|1Pe.1:2]]; ἓν π., [[1Co.12.13|1Co.12:13]], [[Eph.2.18; 4.4|Eph.2:18 4:4]]; ὁ δὲ κύριος τὸ π. ἐστιν, [[2Co.3.17|2Co.3:17]] of that which is effected or governed by the Spirit, opposite to γράμμα, [[Rom.2.29; 7.6|Rom.2:29 7:6]], [[2Co.3.6|2Co.3:6]].
_SYN._: νοῦς, which in NT is contrasted with π. as "the action of the understanding in man with that of the spiritual or ecstatic impulse" (_DB_, iv, 612); ψυχή — the usual term in cl. psychology—in NT, "expresses man as apart from God, a separate individual, π. expresses man as drawing his life from God" (_DB_, 1-vol., 872). (AS)

G4160.def:
**ποιέω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX for a great variety of words, but chiefly for עשׂה ;]
1. **to make, produce, create, cause**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.17.4|Mat.17:4]], [[Mrk.9.5|Mrk.9:5]], [[Jhn.9.11|Jhn.9:11]], [[Act.9.39|Act.9:39]], [[Rom.9.20|Rom.9:20]], al.; of God as Creator (with accusative of person(s) also), [[Mat.19.4|Mat.19:4]], [[Mrk.10.6|Mrk.10:6]], [[Luk.11.40|Luk.11:40]], [[Act.4.24|Act.4:24]], [[Heb.1.2|Heb.1:2]], al.; like Heb. עשׂה, absol. = ἐργάζομαι, **to work**, [[Mat.20.12|Mat.20:12]] (cf. [[Rut.2.19|Rut.2:19]] so AV, but see infr.), [[Rev.13.5|Rev.13:5]], R, mg. (but see infr.); σκάνδαλα, [[Rom.16.17|Rom.16:17]] εἰρεήνην, [[Eph.2.15|Eph.2:15]], [[Jas.3.18|Jas.3:18]]; ἐπίστασιν, [[Act.24.12|Act.24:12]] συστροφήν, [[Act.23.12|Act.23:12]] with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[Luk.1.68|Luk.1:68]], [[Act.15.3|Act.15:3]]; with nouns expressing action or its accomplishment, forming a periphr. for the cogn. verb: ὁδόν π. (cl. ὁ ποιεῖσθαι), **to go on, advance**, [[Mrk.2.23|Mrk.2:23]] πόλεμον, [[Rev.11.7|Rev.11:7]], al.; ἐκδίκησιν, [[Luk.18.7|Luk.18:7]], 8; ἐνέδραν, [[Act.25.3|Act.25:3]] κρίσιν, [[Jhn.5.27|Jhn.5:27]], [[Jude.15|Ju 15]]; ἔργα, [[Jhn.5.36|Jhn.5:36]], al.; (σημεῖα), [[Jhn.2.23|Jhn.2:23]] and freq., [[Act.2.22|Act.2:22]], al.; so also mid. ποιεῖσθαι: μονήν, [[Jhn.14.23|Jhn.14:23]] πορείαν, [[Luk.13.22|Luk.13:22]] κοινωνίαν, [[Rom.15.26|Rom.15:26]] of food, **to make ready, prepare**: δεῖπνον, [[Mrk.6.21|Mrk.6:21]], al.; δοχήν, [[Luk.5.29; 14.13|Luk.5:29 14:13]]; γάμους, [[Mat.22.2|Mat.22:2]] of time, **to spend** (cl.): ὥραν, [[Mat.20.12|Mat.20:12]], RV (but see supr. and cf. McN, in l.); μῆνας, [[Rev.13.5|Rev.13:5]], R, txt. (cf. Swete, in l.; but see supr.); ἐνιαυτόν, [[Jas.4.13|Jas.4:13]] with accusative before ἐκ, [[Jhn.2.15|Jhn.2:15]], al.; with accusative and accusative pred., [[Mat.3.3; 12.16|Mat.3:3 12:16]], [[Mrk.1.3; 3.12|Mrk.1:3 3:12]], [[Jhn.5.11|Jhn.5:11]], al.; with adv., καλῶς, [[Mrk.7.37|Mrk.7:37]] ἑορτὴν π. (Dem., [[Exo.23.16|Exo.23:16]], al.), [[Act.18.21|Act.18:21]], Rec.; πάσχα, [[Mat.26.18|Mat.26:18]] **to make** or **offer a sacrifice** (Plat., Xen., al.; [[Job.42.8|Job.42:8]], [[1Ki.11.33|3Ki.11:33]]; so some understand τοῦτο ποιεῖτε, [[Luk.22.19|Luk.22:19]], but see Abbott, _Essays_, 110ff.); before ἵνα (WM, 422f.; M, _Pr._, 228), [[Jhn.11.37|Jhn.11:37]], [[Col.4.16|Col.4:16]], [[Rev.3.9|Rev.3:9]].
2. **to do, perform, carry out, execute**: absol., with adv., καλῶς π., [[Mat.12.12|Mat.12:12]], [[1Co.7.37, 38|1Co.7:37, 38]] [[Jas.2.19|Jas.2:19]]; id. before ptcp. (cl.; see M, _Pr._, 228), [[Act.10.33|Act.10:33]], [[Php.4.14|Php.4:14]], [[2Pe.1.19|2Pe.1:19]], [[3Jn.6|3Jo.6]]; οὕτως, [[Mat.24.46|Mat.24:46]], [[Luk.9.15|Luk.9:15]], al.; ὡς (καθώς), [[Mat.1.24; 2.16|Mat.1:24 2:16]], al.; ὁμοίως, [[Luk.3.11|Luk.3:11]] ὡσαύτως, [[Mat.20.5|Mat.20:5]] with ptcp., ἀγνοῶν ἐποίησα, [[1Ti.1.13|1Ti.1:13]] with accusative of thing(s): τί interrog., [[Mat.12.3|Mat.12:3]], [[Mrk.2.25|Mrk.2:25]], [[Luk.6.2|Luk.6:2]], al.; τοῦτο, [[Mat.13.28|Mat.13:28]], [[Mrk.5.32|Mrk.5:32]], [[Luk.22.19|Luk.22:19]] (WH om.; see supr., ref. to Abbott, _Essays_), [[Rom.7.20|Rom.7:20]], al.; with nouns expressing command or regulation: τ. νόμον (not as in cl., to _make_ a law), [[Jhn.7.19|Jhn.7:19]], [[Gal.5.3|Gal.5:3]] (cf. in LXX, [[Jos.22.5|Jos.22:5]], [[1Ch.22.12|1Ch.22:12]], al.); τ. ἐντολάς, [[Mat.5.19|Mat.5:19]] similarly with other nouns expressing conduct: τ. δικαιοσύνην, [[Mat.6.1|Mat.6:1]], al.; τ. ἀλήθειαν, [[Jhn.3.21|Jhn.3:21]], al., etc.; with dupl. accusative, [[Mat.27.22|Mat.27:22]], [[Mrk.15.12|Mrk.15:12]]; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s) (commod., incomm.; rare in cl.), [[Mat.7.12|Mat.7:12]], [[Mrk.5.19, 20|Mrk.5:19, 20]] [[Luk.1.49|Luk.1:49]], [[Jhn.9.26|Jhn.9:26]], al.
_SYN.:_ πράσσω, which see The general distinction between the two words is that between particular action and its habitual performance (cf. Tr., _Syn._, §xcvi; Westc. on [[Jhn.3.21|Jhn.3:21]] _ICC_ on [[Rom.1.32|Rom.1:32]]). (AS)

G4165.def:
**ποιμαίνω**
(ποιμήν), [in LXX chiefly for רָעָה ;]
**to act as shepherd, tend flocks**: [[Luk.17.7|Luk.17:7]] with accusative, ποιμνην, [[1Co.9.7|1Co.9:7]] Metaphorical, **to tend, shepherd, govern**: with accusative, [[Mat.2.6|Mat.2:6]] (LXX), [[Jhn.21.16|Jhn.21:16]], [[Act.20.28|Act.20:28]], [[1Pe.5.2|1Pe.5:2]], [[Jude.12|Ju 12]], [[Rev.2.27; 7.17; 12.5; 19.15|Rev.2:27 7:17 12:5 19:15]].†
_SYN._: βόσκω, q.v (AS)

G4198.def:
**πορεύω**,
(πόρος, **a ford, a passage**), [in LXX chiefly for הלךְ ;]
in cl. (the act. becomes obsolete in late Gk.; see M, _Pr._, 162), **to cause to go over, carry, convey**. Mid. (always in LXX and NT), ־ομαι, **to go, proceed, go on one's way**: with accusative, ὁδόν, [[Act.8.39|Act.8:39]] before ἐκεῖθεν, [[Mat.19.15|Mat.19:15]] ἐντεῦθεν, [[Luk.13.31|Luk.13:31]] ἀπό, [[Mat.25.41|Mat.25:41]], [[Luk.4.42|Luk.4:42]]; εἰς, [[Mat.2.20|Mat.2:20]], [[Mrk.16.12|Mrk.16:12]], [[Luk.1.39|Luk.1:39]], [[Jhn.7.35|Jhn.7:35]], al; εἰς εἰρήνην (cf. [[1Ki.1.17|1Ki.1:17]]). [[Luk.7.50|Luk.7:50]]; ἐν εἰρήνῃ, [[Act.16.36|Act.16:36]] ἐπί, with accusative, [[Mat.22.9|Mat.22:9]], [[Act.25.12|Act.25:12]], al; ἕως, [[Act.23.23|Act.23:23]] οὗ, [[Luk.24.28|Luk.24:28]], [[1Co.16.6|1Co.16:6]]; πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.25.9|Mat.25:9]], [[Luk.11.5|Luk.11:5]], al.; κατὰ τ. ὁδόν, [[Act.8.36|Act.8:36]] διά, with genitive, [[Mat.12.1|Mat.12:1]], [[Mrk.9.30|Mrk.9:30]]; with inf., [[Luk.2.3|Luk.2:3]], [[Jhn.14.2|Jhn.14:2]]; σύν, [[Luk.7.6|Luk.7:6]], al.; ἵνα, [[Jhn.11.11|Jhn.11:11]] absol., [[Mat.2.9|Mat.2:9]], [[Luk.7.8|Luk.7:8]], [[Jhn.4.50|Jhn.4:50]], [[Act.5.20|Act.5:20]], al.; ptcp., πορευθείς (on the pass. form of the aor., see M, _Pr._, 161f.), redundant (as in Heb. and Aram.; V. M, _Pr._, 231; Dalman, _Words_, 21), [[Mat.2.8|Mat.2:8]], [[Luk.7.22|Luk.7:22]], al. Metaphorical (cf. Soph., _O.T._, 884; Xen., Cyr., 2, 2, 24, al),
(a) like οἴχομαι in cl., as euphemism for θνήσκω (so הלךְ in [[Gen.15.2|Gen.15:2]]); [[Luk.22.22|Luk.22:22]] and perh. [[Luk.13.33|also 13:33]] (see Field, _Notes_, 66);
(b) in ethical sense ([[Deu.19.9|Deu.19:9]], [[Psa.14.2|Psa.14:2]], al; cf. M, _Pr._, 11.2; Kennedy, _Sources_, 107): before ἐν, [[Luk.1.6|Luk.1:6]], [[1Pe.4.3|1Pe.4:3]], [[2Pe.2.19|2Pe.2:19]]; κατά, with accusative, [[2Pe.3.3|2Pe.3:3]], [[Jude.16, 18|Ju 16, 18]]; with dative (Bl, §38, 3), [[Act.9.31; 14.16|Act.9:31 14:16]], [[Jude.11|Ju 11]];
(with) of disciples or partisans ( [[Jdg.2.12|Jdg.2:12]], [[1Ki.11.10|3Ki.11:10]], [[Sir.46.10|Sir.46:10]]): before ὀπίσω, with genitive of person(s), [[Luk.21.8|Luk.21:8]] (cf. δια-, εἰς-, (-μαι), ἐκ- (-μαι), ἐν- (-μαι), ἐπι- (-μαι), παρα- (-μαι), προ-, προσ- (-μαι), συν- (-μαι)).
(AS)

G4183.def:
**πολύς**, πολλή, πολύ,
[in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;]
1. as _adj._, **much, many, great**, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, [[Act.11.21|Act.11:21]] ὄχλος, [[Mrk.5.24|Mrk.5:24]] θερισμός, [[Mat.9.37|Mat.9:37]] χόρτος, [[Jhn.6.10|Jhn.6:10]] χρόνος, [[Mat.25.19|Mat.25:19]] γογγυσμός, [[Jhn.7.12|Jhn.7:12]] πόνος, [[Col.4.13|Col.4:13]] δόξα, [[Mat.24.30|Mat.24:30]] σιγή, [[Act.21.40|Act.21:40]] pl., προφῆται, [[Mat.13.17|Mat.13:17]] ὄχλοι, [[Mat.4.25|Mat.4:25]] δαιμόνια, [[Mrk.1.34|Mrk.1:34]] δυνάμεις, [[Mat.7.22|Mat.7:22]],
2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, **many** (persons): [[Mat.7.22|Mat.7:22]], [[Mrk.2.2|Mrk.2:2]], al.; with genitive partit., [[Mat.3.7|Mat.3:7]], [[Luk.1.16|Luk.1:16]], al.; before ἐκ, [[Jhn.7.31|Jhn.7:31]], [[Act.17.12|Act.17:12]]; with art., οἱ π., **the many**, [[Mat.24.12|Mat.24:12]], [[Rom.12.5|Rom.12:5]], [[1Co.10.17, 33|1Co.10:17, 33]] [[2Co.2.17|2Co.2:17]]; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., _Notes_, 291), [[Rom.5.15, 19|Rom.5:15, 19]]; neut. pl., πολλά: [[Mat.13.3|Mat.13:3]], [[Mrk.5.26|Mrk.5:26]], al.; accusative with adverbial force, [[Mrk.1.45|Mrk.1:45]], [[Rom.16.6|Rom.16:6]] (Deiss., _LAE_, 317), [[1Co.16.12|1Co.16:12]], [[Jas.3.2|Jas.3:2]], al.; neut. sing., πολύ: [[Luk.12.48|Luk.12:48]] adverbially, [[Mrk.12.27|Mrk.12:27]], al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), [[Mat.26.9|Mat.26:9]] with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, [[2Co.8.22|2Co.8:22]] πολλῷ πλείους, [[Jhn.4.41|Jhn.4:41]]
Compar., **πλείων**
, neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, _App._, 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), **more, greater**;
1. as _adj._: [[Jhn.15.2|Jhn.15:2]], [[Act.18.2|Act.18:2]]o, [[Heb.3.3|Heb.3:3]] before παρά, [[Heb.11.4|Heb.11:4]] (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., [[Act.13.31|Act.13:31]], al.; with genitive compar., [[Mat.21.36|Mat.21:36]] with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), [[Act.4.22; 24.11|Act.4:22 24:11]], al.
2. As subst., οἱ π., **the greater number**: [[Act.10.32; 27.12|Act.10:32 27:12]], [[1Co.10.5; 15.6|1Co.10:5 15:6]]; also (Bl., §44, 3) **others, more, the more**: [[2Co.2.6; 4.15|2Co.2:6 4:15]], [[Php.1.14|Php.1:14]]; πλείονα, [[Luk.11.53|Luk.11:53]] πλειον, πλέον, [[Mat.20.10|Mat.20:10]], [[2Ti.3.9|2Ti.3:9]]; with genitive comp., [[Mrk.12.43|Mk 12:43]], [[Luk.21.3|Luk.21:3]]; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, [[Mat.12.41|Mat.12:41]] adverbially, [[Act.4.17; 20.9; 24.4|Act.4:17 20:9 24:4]].
3. As _adv._, πλεῖον: before ἤ, [[Luk.9.13|Luk.9:13]] with genitive comp., [[Mat.5.20|Mat.5:20]] πλείω: with num., [[Mat.26.53|Mat.26:53]]
Superl., **πλεῖστος**, -η, -ον
, (a) prop., **most**: [[Mat.11.20; 21.8|Mat.11:20 21:8]]; adverbially, τὸ π., [[1Co.14.27|1Co.14:27]]
(b) elative (M, _Pr._, 79), **very great**: ὄχλος π., [[Mrk.4.1|Mrk.4:1]]
(AS)

G4172.def:
**πόλις**, -εως, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for עִיר ;]
**a city**: [[Mat.2.23|Mat.2:23]], [[Mrk.1.45|Mrk.1:45]], [[Luk.4.29|Luk.4:29]], [[Jhn.4.8|Jhn.4:8]], al. mult.; opposite to κῶμαι (κ. καὶ ἀγροί), [[Mat.9.35; 10.11|Mat.9:35 10:11]], [[Mrk.6.56|Mrk.6:56]], [[Luk.8.1; 13.22|Luk.8:1 13:22]]; with nom. propr. in appos. (cl.), [[Act.11.5; 16.14|Act.11:5 16:14]]; with id. in genitive appos. (BL, §35, 5), [[Act.8.5|Act.8:5]], [[2Pe.2.6|2Pe.2:6]]; genitive, of the region, [[Luk.1.26; 4.31|Luk.1:26 4:31]], [[Jhn.4.5|Jhn.4:5]]; of the inhabitants, [[Mat.10.5, 23|Mat.10:5, 23]] [[Luk.23.51|Luk.23:51]], [[Act.19.35|Act.19:35]], [[2Co.11.32|2Co.11:32]]; with genitive of person(s), of one's residence or native place, [[Mat.22.7|Mat.22:7]], [[Luk.2.4, 11; 4.29; 10.11|Luk.2:4, 11 4:29 10:11]], [[Jhn.1.45|Jhn.1:45]], [[Act.16.20|Act.16:20]], [[Rev.16.9|Rev.16:9]]; of Jerusalem: ἡ ἁγία π., [[Mat.4.5; 27.53|Mat.4:5 27:53]], [[Rev.11.2|Rev.11:2]]; ἡ ἠγαπημένη, [[Rev.20.19|Rev.20:19]] π. τοῦ μεγάλου, Mt 5 ̈35 (cf. [[Psa.48.2|Ps 47 (48):2]]); of the heavenly city in the Apocalyptic visions, [[Rev.3.12; 21.2, 10|Rev.3:12 21:2, 10]] 14ff. 22:14, 19. By meton., of the inhabitants of a city: [[Mat.8.34; 12.25; 21.10|Mat.8:34 12:25 21:10]], [[Mrk.1.33|Mrk.1:33]], [[Act.14.21; 21.30|Act.14:21 21:30]].
(AS)

G4143.def:
**πλοῖον**, -ον, τό
(πλέω), [in LXX chiefly for אֳנִיָּה ;]
a boat, also (= obsolete ναῦς) a ship: [[Mat.4.21-22|Mat.4:21-22]], and frequently in Gosp. and Ac, [[Jas.3.4|Jas.3:4]], [[Rev.8.9; 18.19|Rev.8:9 18:19]].
(AS)

G4164.def:
**ποικίλος**, -η, -ον
[in LXX for נָקֹד, רִקְמָה, etc. ;]
many-coloured, variegated. Metaphorical, **various, manifold**: [[Mat.4.24|Mat.4:24]], [[Mrk.1.34|Mrk.1:34]], [[Luk.4.40|Luk.4:40]], [[2Ti.3.6|2Ti.3:6]], [[Tit.3.3|Tit.3:3]], [[Heb.2.4; 13.9|Heb.2:4 13:9]], [[Jas.1.2|Jas.1:2]], [[1Pe.1.6; 4.10|1Pe.1:6 4:10]].†
(AS)

G4119.def:
**πλέον**, see: πολύς.
**πολύς**, πολλή, πολύ,
[in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;]
1. as _adj._, **much, many, great**, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, [[Act.11.21|Act.11:21]] ὄχλος, [[Mrk.5.24|Mrk.5:24]] θερισμός, [[Mat.9.37|Mat.9:37]] χόρτος, [[Jhn.6.10|Jhn.6:10]] χρόνος, [[Mat.25.19|Mat.25:19]] γογγυσμός, [[Jhn.7.12|Jhn.7:12]] πόνος, [[Col.4.13|Col.4:13]] δόξα, [[Mat.24.30|Mat.24:30]] σιγή, [[Act.21.40|Act.21:40]] pl., προφῆται, [[Mat.13.17|Mat.13:17]] ὄχλοι, [[Mat.4.25|Mat.4:25]] δαιμόνια, [[Mrk.1.34|Mrk.1:34]] δυνάμεις, [[Mat.7.22|Mat.7:22]],
2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, **many** (persons): [[Mat.7.22|Mat.7:22]], [[Mrk.2.2|Mrk.2:2]], al.; with genitive partit., [[Mat.3.7|Mat.3:7]], [[Luk.1.16|Luk.1:16]], al.; before ἐκ, [[Jhn.7.31|Jhn.7:31]], [[Act.17.12|Act.17:12]]; with art., οἱ π., **the many**, [[Mat.24.12|Mat.24:12]], [[Rom.12.5|Rom.12:5]], [[1Co.10.17, 33|1Co.10:17, 33]] [[2Co.2.17|2Co.2:17]]; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., _Notes_, 291), [[Rom.5.15, 19|Rom.5:15, 19]]; neut. pl., πολλά: [[Mat.13.3|Mat.13:3]], [[Mrk.5.26|Mrk.5:26]], al.; accusative with adverbial force, [[Mrk.1.45|Mrk.1:45]], [[Rom.16.6|Rom.16:6]] (Deiss., _LAE_, 317), [[1Co.16.12|1Co.16:12]], [[Jas.3.2|Jas.3:2]], al.; neut. sing., πολύ: [[Luk.12.48|Luk.12:48]] adverbially, [[Mrk.12.27|Mrk.12:27]], al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), [[Mat.26.9|Mat.26:9]] with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, [[2Co.8.22|2Co.8:22]] πολλῷ πλείους, [[Jhn.4.41|Jhn.4:41]]
Compar., **πλείων**
, neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, _App._, 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), **more, greater**;
1. as _adj._: [[Jhn.15.2|Jhn.15:2]], [[Act.18.2|Act.18:2]]o, [[Heb.3.3|Heb.3:3]] before παρά, [[Heb.11.4|Heb.11:4]] (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., [[Act.13.31|Act.13:31]], al.; with genitive compar., [[Mat.21.36|Mat.21:36]] with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), [[Act.4.22; 24.11|Act.4:22 24:11]], al.
2. As subst., οἱ π., **the greater number**: [[Act.10.32; 27.12|Act.10:32 27:12]], [[1Co.10.5; 15.6|1Co.10:5 15:6]]; also (Bl., §44, 3) **others, more, the more**: [[2Co.2.6; 4.15|2Co.2:6 4:15]], [[Php.1.14|Php.1:14]]; πλείονα, [[Luk.11.53|Luk.11:53]] πλειον, πλέον, [[Mat.20.10|Mat.20:10]], [[2Ti.3.9|2Ti.3:9]]; with genitive comp., [[Mrk.12.43|Mk 12:43]], [[Luk.21.3|Luk.21:3]]; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, [[Mat.12.41|Mat.12:41]] adverbially, [[Act.4.17; 20.9; 24.4|Act.4:17 20:9 24:4]].
3. As _adv._, πλεῖον: before ἤ, [[Luk.9.13|Luk.9:13]] with genitive comp., [[Mat.5.20|Mat.5:20]] πλείω: with num., [[Mat.26.53|Mat.26:53]]
Superl., **πλεῖστος**, -η, -ον
, (a) prop., **most**: [[Mat.11.20; 21.8|Mat.11:20 21:8]]; adverbially, τὸ π., [[1Co.14.27|1Co.14:27]]
(b) elative (M, _Pr._, 79), **very great**: ὄχλος π., [[Mrk.4.1|Mrk.4:1]]
(AS)

G4139.def:
**πλησίος**, -α, -ον
(πέλας, near),
near, close by, neighbouring. As adv., πλησίον = πέλας, **near**: with genitive, [[Jhn.4.5|Jhn.4:5]] with art., ὁ π., one's neigh­bour
[in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ ]:
[[Luk.10.29, 36|Luk.10:29, 36]], [[Act.7.27|Act.7:27]], [[Rom.13.10; 15.2|Rom.13:10 15:2]], [[Eph.4.25|Eph.4:25]], [[Jas.4.12|Jas.4:12]]; ἀγαπήσεις τὸν π. σου ὡς σεαυτόν ([[Lev.19.18|Lev.19:18]], LXX), [[Mat.5.43; 19.19; 22.39|Mat.5:43 19:19 22:39]], [[Mrk.12.31, 33|Mrk.12:31, 33]], [[Luk.10.27|Luk.10:27]], [[Rom.13.9|Rom.13:9]], [[Gal.5.14|Gal.5:14]], [[Jas.2.8|Jas.2:8]] (on the various senses of ὁ π. in OT, NT, see _DB_, iii, 511; DCC, ii, 240 f.).†
(AS)

G4102.def:
**πίστις**, -εως, ἡ
(πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמוּנָה ;]
1. in active sense, **faith, belief, trust, confidence**, in NT always of religious faith in God or Christ or spiritual things: [[Mat.8.10|Mat.8:10]], [[Luk.5.20|Luk.5:20]], [[Act.14.9|Act.14:9]], [[Rom.1.8|Rom.1:8]], [[1Co.2.5|1Co.2:5]], [[2Co.1.24|2Co.1:24]], [[1Ti.1.5|1Ti.1:5]], al.; with genitive obj., [[Mrk.11.22|Mrk.11:22]], [[Act.3.16|Act.3:16]], [[Rom.3.22|Rom.3:22]], [[Gal.2.16|Gal.2:16]], [[Eph.3.12|Eph.3:12]], [[Jas.2.1|Jas.2:1]], al.; with prep., ἐν, [[Rom.3.25|Rom.3:25]], [[Gal.3.26|Gal.3:26]], [[Eph.1.15|Eph.1:15]], [[Col.1.24|Col.1:24]], [[1Ti.1.14; 3.13|1Ti.1:14 3:13]], [[2Ti.1.13; 3.15|2Ti.1:13 3:15]], [[2Pe.1.1|2Pe.1:1]]; εἰς, [[Act.20.21; 24.24; 26.18|Act.20:21 24:24 26:18]], [[Col.2.5|Col.2:5]], [[1Pe.1.21|1Pe.1:21]]; πρός, [[1Th.1.8|1Th.1:8]], Phm 5; ἐπί, with accusative [[Heb.6.1|Heb.6:1]] ἐν τῇ π. στήκειν (εἶναι, μένειν), [[1Co.16.13|1Co.16:13]], [[1Co.13.5|1Co.13:5]], [[1Ti.2.15|1Ti.2:15]]; ὑπακοὴ τῆς π., [[Rom.1.5; 16.26|Rom.1:5 16:26]]; ὁ ἐκ π., [[Rom.3.26; 4.16|Rom.3:26 4:16]], [[Gal.3.12|Gal.3:12]]; διὰ (τῆς) π., [[Rom.3.30|Rom.3:30]], [[Gal.2.16|Gal.2:16]], [[Php.3.9|Php.3:9]]. By meton., objectively, that which is the object or content of belief, **the faith**: [[Act.6.7; 14.22|Act.6:7 14:22]], [[Gal.1.23; 3.23; 6.10|Gal.1:23 3:23 6:10]], [[Php.1.26, 27|Php.1:26, 27]] [[Jude.3,20|Ju 3, 20]], and perh. also [[Act.13.8; 16.5|Act.13:8 16:5]], [[Rom.1.5|Rom.1:5]] [[Rom.16.26|and 16:26]] (see supr.), [[1Co.16.13|1Co.16:13]], [[Col.1.23|Col.1:23]], [[2Th.3.2|2Th.3:2]] (Lft., _Notes_, 125), [[1Ti.1.19; 3.9; 4.1, 6; 5.8|1Ti.1:19 3:9 4:1, 6 5:8]] [[1Tim.6.10|6:10]], 12, [[2Ti.3.8; 4.7|2Ti.3:8 4:7]] [[Tit.1.4, 13; 3.15|Tit.1:4, 13 3:15]], [[1Pe.5.9|1Pe.5:9]].
2. In passive sense,
(a) **fidelity, faithfulness**: [[Mat.23.23|Mat.23:23]], [[Gal.5.22|Gal.5:22]]; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, [[Rom.3.3|Rom.3:3]]
(b) objectively, **plighted faith, a pledge** of fidelity: [[1Ti.5.12|1Ti.5:12]] (On the various shades of meaning in which the word is used in NT, see esp. _ICC_ on [[Rom.1.17|Rom.1:17]], pp. 31ff.; Lft., _Ga._, 154ff.; Stevens, _Th. NT_, 422, 515ff.; _DB_, i, 830ff.; Cremer, see word)
(AS)

G4100.def:
**πιστεύω**,
[in LXX chiefly for אמן hi. ;]
1. intrans., **to have faith** (in), **to believe**; in cl., with accusative, dative, in NT also with prep, (on the significance of the various constructions, see M, _Pr._, 67f.; Vau. on [[Rom.4.5|Rom.4:5]] Ellic. on [[1Ti.1.16|1Ti.1:16]] Abbott, _JV_, 19-80): absol., [[Mat.24.23, 26|Mat.24:23, 26]] [[Mrk.13.21|Mrk.13:21]], [[1Co.11.18|1Co.11:18]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.13.41|Act.13:41]], [[1Co.13.7|1Co.13:7]]; with dative of person(s) (to believe what one says), Mrk.16:[13, 14], [[1Jn.4.1|1Jn.4:1]]; τ. ψεύδει, [[2Th.2.11|2Th.2:11]] περί . . . ὅτι, [[Jhn.9.18|Jhn.9:18]] esp. and most frequently with reference to religious belief: absol., [[Mat.8.13|Mat.8:13]], [[Mrk.5.36|Mrk.5:36]], [[Luk.8.50|Luk.8:50]], [[Jhn.11.40|Jhn.11:40]], al.; before ὅτι, [[Mat.9.28|Mat.9:28]], al.; with dative (see supr., and cf. _DB_, i, 829a), [[Jhn.3.12; 5.24; 6.30; 8.31|Jhn.3:12 5:24 6:30 8:31]], [[Act.16.34|Act.16:34]], [[Gal.3.6|Gal.3:6]]" (LXX), [[2Ti.1.12|2Ti.1:12]], [[1Jn.5.10|1Jn.5:10]], al.; with prep., (expressing personal trust and reliance as distinct from mere credence or belief; see M, _Pr._, l.with; _DB_, i, 829b), **to believe in or on**: ἐν (Psa.77 (78):22, al.), [[Mrk.1.15|Mrk.1:15]] (see Swete, in l.); εἰς, [[Mat.18.6|Mat.18:6]], [[Jhn.2.11|Jhn.2:11]] (see Westc., in l.), and freq., [[Act.10.43; 19.4|Act.10:43 19:4]], [[Rom.10.14|Rom.10:14]], [[Gal.2.16|Gal.2:16]], [[Php.1.29|Php.1:29]], I [[Jhn.5.10|Jhn.5:10]], [[1Pe.1.8|1Pe.1:8]]; εἰς τ. ὄνομα, [[Jhn.1.12; 2.23; 3.18|Jhn.1:12 2:23 3:18]], [[1Jn.5.13|1Jn.5:13]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[Mat.27.42|Mat.27:42]], [[Act.9.42; 11.17; 16.31; 22.19|Act.9:42 11:17 16:31 22:19]], [[Rom.4.5|Rom.4:5]]; ἐπί, with dative, [[Rom.9.33|Rom.9:33]] (LXX) 10:11 (ib.), [[1Ti.1.16|1Ti.1:16]], [[1Pe.2.6|1Pe.2:6]]" (LXX) ; ptcp. pres., οἱ π., as subst., [[Act.2.44|Act.2:44]], [[Rom.3.22|Rom.3:22]], [[1Co.1.21|1Co.1:21]], al.; aor., Mrk.16:[16], [[Act.4.32|Act.4:32]]; pf., [[Act.19.18; 21.20|Act.19:18 21:20]] (on Johannine use of the tenses of π., see Westc, _Epp. Jo._, 120).
2. Trans., **to entrust**: with accusative and dative, [[Luk.16.11|Luk.16:11]], [[Jhn.2.24|Jhn.2:24]]; pass., **to be entrusted with**: with accusative, [[Rom.3.2|Rom.3:2]], [[1Co.9.17|1Co.9:17]], [[Gal.2.7|Gal.2:7]], [[1Th.2.4|1Th.2:4]] (see Lft., _Notes_, 21f.), [[1Ti.1.11|1Ti.1:11]], [[Tit.1.3|Tit.1:3]].
(AS)

G4138.def:
**πλήρωμα**, -τος, τό
(πληρόω), [in LXX for מְלֹא ;]
the result of the action involved in πληρόω (Lft., Col., 255 if.; AR, _Eph._, 255 ff.), hence,
1. in passive sense, that which has been completed, complement, plenitude, fullness (in Xen., Luc., Polyb., al., of a ship's crew or cargo, and by meton. of the ship itself) : [[Jhn.1.16|Jhn.1:16]], [[Rom.11.12, 25; 15.29|Rom.11:12, 25 15:29]], [[1Co.10.26|1Co.10:26]]" (LXX) [[Eph.1.23|Eph.1:23]] (AR, 42 ff.) [[Eph.3.19|Eph.3:19]] (AR. 87 ff.) [[Eph.4.13|Eph.4:13]], [[Col.1.19; 2.9|Col.1:19 2:9]]; of time, [[Gal.4.4|Gal.4:4]], [[Eph.1.10|Eph.1:10]]; κοφίνων (σφυρίδων) πληρώματα, basketfuls, [[Mrk.6.43; 8.20|Mrk.6:43 8:20]].
2. In active sense (= πλήρωσις, as frequently in words of these formations, cf. κτίσις, and see MM, xx);
(a) that which fills up (but see Lft., l.with) : [[Mat.9.16|Mat.9:16]], [[Mrk.2.21|Mrk.2:21]];
(b) **a filling up, completing, fulfilment**: [[Rom.13.10|Rom.13:10]]†
(AS)

G4118.def:
**πλεῖστος**, πλείων, see: πολύς.
**πολύς**, πολλή, πολύ,
[in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;]
1. as _adj._, **much, many, great**, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, [[Act.11.21|Act.11:21]] ὄχλος, [[Mrk.5.24|Mrk.5:24]] θερισμός, [[Mat.9.37|Mat.9:37]] χόρτος, [[Jhn.6.10|Jhn.6:10]] χρόνος, [[Mat.25.19|Mat.25:19]] γογγυσμός, [[Jhn.7.12|Jhn.7:12]] πόνος, [[Col.4.13|Col.4:13]] δόξα, [[Mat.24.30|Mat.24:30]] σιγή, [[Act.21.40|Act.21:40]] pl., προφῆται, [[Mat.13.17|Mat.13:17]] ὄχλοι, [[Mat.4.25|Mat.4:25]] δαιμόνια, [[Mrk.1.34|Mrk.1:34]] δυνάμεις, [[Mat.7.22|Mat.7:22]],
2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, **many** (persons): [[Mat.7.22|Mat.7:22]], [[Mrk.2.2|Mrk.2:2]], al.; with genitive partit., [[Mat.3.7|Mat.3:7]], [[Luk.1.16|Luk.1:16]], al.; before ἐκ, [[Jhn.7.31|Jhn.7:31]], [[Act.17.12|Act.17:12]]; with art., οἱ π., **the many**, [[Mat.24.12|Mat.24:12]], [[Rom.12.5|Rom.12:5]], [[1Co.10.17, 33|1Co.10:17, 33]] [[2Co.2.17|2Co.2:17]]; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., _Notes_, 291), [[Rom.5.15, 19|Rom.5:15, 19]]; neut. pl., πολλά: [[Mat.13.3|Mat.13:3]], [[Mrk.5.26|Mrk.5:26]], al.; accusative with adverbial force, [[Mrk.1.45|Mrk.1:45]], [[Rom.16.6|Rom.16:6]] (Deiss., _LAE_, 317), [[1Co.16.12|1Co.16:12]], [[Jas.3.2|Jas.3:2]], al.; neut. sing., πολύ: [[Luk.12.48|Luk.12:48]] adverbially, [[Mrk.12.27|Mrk.12:27]], al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), [[Mat.26.9|Mat.26:9]] with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, [[2Co.8.22|2Co.8:22]] πολλῷ πλείους, [[Jhn.4.41|Jhn.4:41]]
Compar., **πλείων**
, neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, _App._, 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), **more, greater**;
1. as _adj._: [[Jhn.15.2|Jhn.15:2]], [[Act.18.2|Act.18:2]]o, [[Heb.3.3|Heb.3:3]] before παρά, [[Heb.11.4|Heb.11:4]] (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., [[Act.13.31|Act.13:31]], al.; with genitive compar., [[Mat.21.36|Mat.21:36]] with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), [[Act.4.22; 24.11|Act.4:22 24:11]], al.
2. As subst., οἱ π., **the greater number**: [[Act.10.32; 27.12|Act.10:32 27:12]], [[1Co.10.5; 15.6|1Co.10:5 15:6]]; also (Bl., §44, 3) **others, more, the more**: [[2Co.2.6; 4.15|2Co.2:6 4:15]], [[Php.1.14|Php.1:14]]; πλείονα, [[Luk.11.53|Luk.11:53]] πλειον, πλέον, [[Mat.20.10|Mat.20:10]], [[2Ti.3.9|2Ti.3:9]]; with genitive comp., [[Mrk.12.43|Mk 12:43]], [[Luk.21.3|Luk.21:3]]; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, [[Mat.12.41|Mat.12:41]] adverbially, [[Act.4.17; 20.9; 24.4|Act.4:17 20:9 24:4]].
3. As _adv._, πλεῖον: before ἤ, [[Luk.9.13|Luk.9:13]] with genitive comp., [[Mat.5.20|Mat.5:20]] πλείω: with num., [[Mat.26.53|Mat.26:53]]
Superl., **πλεῖστος**, -η, -ον
, (a) prop., **most**: [[Mat.11.20; 21.8|Mat.11:20 21:8]]; adverbially, τὸ π., [[1Co.14.27|1Co.14:27]]
(b) elative (M, _Pr._, 79), **very great**: ὄχλος π., [[Mrk.4.1|Mrk.4:1]]
(AS)

G4155.def:
**πνίγω **
[in LXX: [[1Sa.16.14-15|1Ki.16:14-15]] (בָּעַת pi.) * ;]
**to choke**: with accusative, [[Mat.13.7|Mat.13:7]] (WH, mg.); imperfect (coniative), [[Mat.18.28|Mat.18:28]] of drowning, pass., [[Mrk.5.13|Mrk.5:13]] (cf. ἀπο-, ἐπι-, συν-πνίγω).†
(AS)

G4186.def:
**πολύτιμος**, -ον
(πολύς, τιμή)
1. much revered (Menand.).
2. **very costly, very precious**: [[Mat.13.46; 26.7|Mat.13:46 26:7]] (βαρύτιμος, WH), [[Jhn.12.3|Jhn.12:3]] comparat., [[1Pe.1.7|1Pe.1:7]]†
(AS)

G4134.def:
**πλήρης**, -ες
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא ;]
1. **full, filled**: [[Mat.14.20; 15.37|Mat.14:20 15:37]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[Mrk.8.19|Mrk.8:19]] λέπρας, [[Luk.5.12|Luk.5:12]] metaphorically, of the soul: πνεύματος ἀγίου, [[Luk.4.1|Luk.4:1]], [[Act.6.3; 7.55; 11.24|Act.6:3 7:55 11:24]]; πίστεως, [[Act.6.5|Act.6:5]] χάριτος, ib. [[Act.6.8|Act.6:8]] χ. καὶ ἀληθείας (where π. is indecl.; see M, _Pr._, 50; Milligan, _NTD_, 65, with reff. in each), [[Jhn.1.14|Jhn.1:14]] δόλου, [[Act.13.10|Act.13:10]] θυμοῦ, [[Act.19.28|Act.19:28]] ἔργων ἀγαθῶν, [[Act.9.36|Act.9:36]]
2. **full, complete**: μισθός, [[2Jn.8|II Jn 8]]; σῖτος (π. prob. in­decl. here; see on [[Jhn.1.14|Jhn.1:14]], supr.), [[Mrk.4.28|Mrk.4:28]]†
(AS)

G4130.def:
**πίμπλημι **
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, also for שָׂבַע ;]
trans. form in present and imperfect of πλήθω (intrans. in these tenses), which supplies the other tense forms;
**to fill**: with accusative, [[Luk.5.7|Luk.5:7]] with accusative and genitive, [[Mat.27.48|Mat.27:48]] pass., [[Mat.22.10|Mat.22:10]], [[Act.19.29|Act.19:29]]; of that which fills or takes possession of the mind : pass., with genitive, [[Luk.1.15, 41; 1.67; 4.28; 5.26; 6.11|Luk.1:15, 41 1:67 4:28 5:26 6:11]], [[Act.2.4; 3.10; 4.8, 31; 5.17; 9.17; 13.9, 45|Act.2:4 3:10 4:8, 31 5:17 9:17 13:9, 45]]. Metaphorical (as in LXX for מָלֵא: [[Gen.29.27|Gen.29:27]], [[Job.15.32|Job.15:32]]), **to complete, fulfil**: pass., of prophecy, [[Luk.21.22|Luk.21:22]] of time, [[Luk.1.23, 57; 2.6, 21-22|Luk.1:23, 57 2:6, 21-22]] (cf. ἐμ-πίμπλημι).†
πλήθω, see: πίμπλημι
_SYN._: πληροφορέω, πληρόω (AS)

G4189.def:
**πονηρία**, -ας, ἡ
(πονηρός), [in LXX chiefly for רַע ;]
**iniquity, wickedness**: [[Mat.22.18|Mat.22:18]], [[Luk.11.39|Luk.11:39]], [[Rom.1.29|Rom.1:29]], [[Eph.6.12|Eph.6:12]]; pl. (see Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, _Mk._, 153), [[Mrk.7.22|Mrk.7:22]], [[Act.3.26|Act.3:26]]; κακία καὶ π., [[1Co.5.8|1Co.5:8]]†
_SYN._: see: κακία. (AS)

G4115.def:
**πλατύνω**
(πλατύς), [in LXX chiefly for רָחַב hi. ;]
**to make broad, enlarge, extend**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.23.5|Mat.23:5]] Metaphorical (cf. [[Psa.119.32|Psa.119:32]], al.), pass., ἡ καρδία, [[2Co.6.11|2Co.6:11]] ὑμεῖς, [[2Co.6.13|2Co.6:13]]†
(AS)

G4171.def:
**πόλεμος**, -ον, ό
[in LXX chiefly for מִלְחָמָה ;]
1. **war**: [[Mat.24.6|Mat.24:6]], [[Mrk.13.7|Mrk.13:7]], [[Luk.14.31; 21.9|Luk.14:31 21:9]], [[Heb.11.34|Heb.11:34]]; π. ποιεῖν, before μετά, with genitive (cf. πολεμέω), [[Rev.11.7; 12.17; 13.7; 19.19|Rev.11:7 12:17 13:7 19:19]].
2. **= μάχη, a fight, battle**: [[1Co.14.8|1Co.14:8]], [[Rev.9.7, 9; 12.7; 16.14; 20.8|Rev.9:7, 9 12:7 16:14 20:8]]; hyperb., of private quarrels (cf. πολεμέω), [[Jas.4.1|Jas.4:1]]†
(AS)

G4129.def:
**πληθύνω**
(causal of πληθύω, to be full, πληθύς, Ion. for πλῆθος), [in LXX chiefly for רָבָה hi. ;]
1. trans., **to increase, multiply**: [[2Co.9.10; 6.14|2Co.9:10 6:14]]" (LXX) ; pass., **to be increased, to multiply**: [[Mat.24.12|Mat.24:12]], [[Act.6.7; 7.17; 9.31; 12.24|Act.6:7 7:17 9:31 12:24]]; with dative of person(s) ([[Dan.3.31|Dan LXX TH 3:31]](98) al.), [[1Pe.1.2|1Pe.1:2]], [[2Pe.1.2|2Pe.1:2]], [[Jude.2|Ju 2]].
2. Intrans., **to be increased, to multiply**: [[Act.6.1|Act.6:1]]†
(AS)

G4167.def:
**ποίμνη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Gen.32.16|Gen.32:16]] (17) (עֵדֶר), [[Zec.13.7|Zec.13:7]] A * ;]
a flock, prop., of sheep: [[Mat.26.31|Mat.26:31]], [[Luk.2.8|Luk.2:8]], [[1Co.9.7|1Co.9:7]]. Metaphorical, of Christ's followers, [[Jhn.10.16|Jhn.10:16]]†
(AS)

G4108.def:
**πλάνος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[Job.19.4|Job.19:4]] (מְשׁוּגָה), [[Jer.23.32|Jer.23:32]] * ;]
1. wandering.
2. **leading astray, deceiving**: πνεύματα π., [[1Ti.4.1|1Ti.4:1]] As subst., ὁ π., **a deceiver, impostor**: [[Mat.27.63|Mat.27:63]], [[2Co.6.8; 6.1-18|2Co.6:8 6:1-18]] [[2Jn.1.7|2Jn.1:7]].†
(AS)

G4106.def:
**πλάνη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Pro.14.8|Pro.14:8]] (מִרְמָה), [[Wis.1.12|Wis.1:12]], al ;]
a wandering. Metaphorical, **a going astray, an error **(in NT always with respect to morals or religion): [[Mat.27.64|Mat.27:64]], [[Rom.1.27|Rom.1:27]], [[Eph.4.14|Eph.4:14]], [[1Th.2.3|1Th.2:3]], [[2Th.2.11|2Th.2:11]], [[Jas.5.20|Jas.5:20]], [[2Pe.2.18; 3.17; 3.1-18|2Pe.2:18 3:17 3:1-18]]; [[1Jn.4.6|1Jn.4:6]], [[Jude.11|Ju 11]].†
(AS)

G4128.def:
**πλῆθος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for רֹב, also for הָמוֹן, etc. ;]
1. **a great number, a multitude**;
(a) **of things **: ἰχθύων, [[Luk.5.6|Luk.5:6]], [[Jhn.21.6|Jhn.21:6]]; φρυγάνων, [[Act.28.3|Act.28:3]] ἁμαρτιίῶν, [[Jas.5.20|Jas.5:20]], [[1Pe.4.8|1Pe.4:8]]; τ. πλήθει, in multitude, [[Heb.11.12|Heb.11:12]]
(b) **of persons**: [[Act.21.22|Act.21:22]] (WH, R, om.); with genitive, [[Luk.2.13|Luk.2:13]], [[Jhn.5.3|Jhn.5:3]], [[Act.5.14|Act.5:14]]; π. πολύ (πολὺ π.), [[Mrk.3.7-8;|Mrk.3:7-8]] id. with genitive, [[Luk.6.17; 23.27|Luk.6:17 23:27]], [[Act.14.1; 17.4|Act.14:1 17:4]]
2. Of persons, with art., the whole number, the multitude (in Plat., Thuc., Xen., al., = δῆμος, the commons, or-opposite to δῆμος-the populace) : [[Act.2.6; 15.30; 19.9; 23.7|Act.2:6 15:30 19:9 23:7]]; τ. λαοῦ, [[Act.21.36|Act.21:36]] τ. πόλεως, [[Act.14.4|Act.14:4]] πᾶν τὸ π., [[Act.15.12|Act.15:12]] with genitive, [[Luk.1.10; 8.37; 19.37; 23.1|Luk.1:10 8:37 19:37 23:1]], [[Act.4.32; 5.16; 6.2, 5; 25.24|Act.4:32 5:16 6:2, 5 25:24]].†
(AS)

G4142.def:
**πλοιάριον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of πλοῖον),
**a boat**: [[Mrk.3.9|Mrk.3:9]], [[Luk.5.2|Luk.5:2]] (πλοῖα, WH, txt., R), [[Jhn.6.22-23|Jhn.6:22-23]] (πλοῖα, WH) [[Jhn.6.24; 21.8|Jhn.6:24 21:8]].†
(AS)

G4124.def:
**πλεονεξία**, -ας, ἡ
(πλεονέκτης), [in LXX for בֶּצַע ;]
the character and conduct of a πλεονέκτης.
1. advantage.
2. **desire for advantage, grasping, aggression, cupidity, covetousness**: [[Luk.12.15|Luk.12:15]], [[Rom.1.29|Rom.1:29]], [[2Co.9.5|2Co.9:5]], [[Eph.4.19|Eph.4:19]] (see _ICC_, in l) [[Eph.5.3|Eph.5:3]], [[Col.3.5|Col.3:5]], [[1Th.2.5|1Th.2:5]], [[2Pe.2.3; 2.14|2Pe.2:3 2:14]]; pl. (see Bl., § 32, 6), [[Mrk.7.22|Mrk.7:22]]†
_SYN._: φιλαργυρία, avarice (see Tr., _Syn._, § xxiv) (AS)

G4101.def:
**πιστικός**, -ή, -όν (πίστις),
1. having the gift of persuasion (Plat., _Gorg._, 455A).
2.
(a) of persons, **faithful, trusty** (Plut.);
(b) of things, **trustworthy, genuine**: νάρδος π., [[Mrk.14.3|Mrk.14:3]], [[Jhn.12.3|Jhn.12:3]].
† (AS)

G4185.def:
**πολυτελής**, -ές
(πολύς, τέλος) [in LXX for יָקָר, etc. ;]
**very costly, very precious, of great value**: [[Mrk.14.3|Mrk.14:3]], [[1Ti.2.9|1Ti.2:9]]; metaphorically, [[1Pe.3.4|1Pe.3:4]]†
(AS)

G4135.def:
**πληροφορέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Ecc.8.11|Ecc.8:11]] (מָלֵא) * ;]
1. **to bring in full measure, hence, to fulfil, accomplish**: [[Luk.1.1|Luk.1:1]], [[2Ti.4.5; 4.17|2Ti.4:5 4:17]].
2. **to persuade, assure or satisfy fully **(so in π.; see Deiss., _LAE_, 82 f.; M, _Th._, 9): pass., [[Rom.4.21; 14.5|Rom.4:21 14:5]], [[Col.4.12|Col.4:12]] (see Lft., in l).
3. **to fill**: [[Rom.15.13|Rom.15:13]], L, mg. (Cl. Ro., [[1Co.5.4|1Co.5:4]]); metaphorically, pass., to be filled with, hence, fully bent on (Ec, l.with).†
(AS)

G4147.def:
**πλουτέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for עָשַׁר hi. ;]
to be rich, aor., **to become rich**: [[Luk.1.53|Luk.1:53]], [[1Ti.6.9|1Ti.6:9]]; before ἀπό ([[Sir.11.18|Sir.11:18]]), [[Rev.18.15|Rev.18:15]]; ἐκ, [[Rev.18.3, 19|Rev.18:3, 19]]; ἐν (= cl., with genitive, dative, accusative, cf. πλούσιος), [[1Ti.6.18|1Ti.6:18]] Metaphorical, π. εἰς θεόν, [[Luk.12.21|Luk.12:21]] of God, εἰς πάντας, [[Rom.10.12|Rom.10:12]] aor., I became rich, [[1Co.4.8|1Co.4:8]], [[2Co.8.9|2Co.8:9]], [[Rev.3.18|Rev.3:18]]; pf., I have become rich, [[Rev.3.17|Rev.3:17]]†
(AS)

G4194.def:
**Πόντιος**, -ου, ὁ
Pontius, the prænomen of Pilate (see: Πειλᾶτος), [[Mat.27.2|Mat.27:2]] (Rec., WH, mg.), [[Luk.3.1|Luk.3:1]], [[Act.4.27|Act.4:27]], [[1Ti.6.13|1Ti.6:13]].†
(AS)

G4150.def:
**πλύνω **
[in LXX chiefly for כָּבַס pi. ;]
**to wash **(inanimate objects, esp. clothing): τ. δίκτυα, [[Luk.5.2|Luk.5:2]] Fig., τ. στολάς, [[Rev.7.14; 22.14|Rev.7:14 22:14]] (cf. [[Psa.51.4|Psa.51:4]], 9 and see: ἀπο-πλύνω).†
_SYN._: see: λούω (AS)

G4132.def:
**πλήμμυρα**, -ης (for Att.. -ας, see Bl., § 7, 1)
(πλήθω), [in LXX: π. γένεσθαι, [[Job.40.18|Job.40:18]] (23) (נָהָר עָשַׁק) * ;]
a flood (of sea or river) : [[Luk.6.48|Luk.6:48]]†
(AS)

G4168.def:
**ποίμνιον**, -ου, τό, = ποίμνη, which see
[in LXX chiefly for צֹאן, also for עֵדֶר, etc. ;]
a flock, prop., of sheep. Metaphorical, of Christians: [[Luk.12.32|Luk.12:32]], [[Act.20.23, 28|Act.20:23, 28]], [[1Pe.5.3|1Pe.5:3]]; τ. θεοῦ, ib. [[1Pe.5.2|1Pe.5:2]]†
(AS)

G4197.def:
**πορεία**, -ας, ἡ
(πορεύω), [in LXX chiefly for הֲלִיכָה and cogn. forms ;]
1. **a journey**: [[Luk.13.22|Luk.13:22]]
2. **a going**: metaphorically ("the rich man perishes while he is still on the move," Hort., in l), [[Jas.1.11|Jas.1:11]]†
(AS)

G4177.def:
**πολίτης**, -ου, ὁ
(πόλις), [in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ ;]
1. **a citizen**: with genitive loc., [[Luk.15.15|Luk.15:15]], [[Act.21.39|Act.21:39]].
2. **a fellow-citizen**: with genitive of person(s), [[Luk.19.14|Luk.19:14]], [[Heb.8.11|Heb.8:11]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4179.def:
**πολλαπλασίων**, -ον
(πόλυς),
= πολλαπλάσιος,
**many times more**: [[Mat.19.29|Mat.19:29]], [[Luk.18.30|Luk.18:30]].†
ἑπταπλασίων, -ον,
genitive, -ονος,
[in LXX for שִׁבְעָתַיִם, [[Psa.79.12|Psa.79:12]], al. ;]
**sevenfold**: [[Luk.18.30|Luk.18:30]] (WH, mg., for πολλαπλ- WH, txt., RV; see WH, _Notes_, 62).†
(AS)

G4125.def:
**πλευρά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX (frequently pl. as in Hom.) chiefly for צֵלָע ;]
**the side**: [[Mat.27.49|Mat.27:49]] ([[WH]] R, mg.), [[Jhn.19.34; 20.20, 25; 20.27|Jhn.19:34 20:20, 25 20:27]] [[Act.12.7|Act.12:7]].†
(AS)

G4157.def:
**πνοή**, -ῆς, ή
(πνέω), [in LXX chiefly for נְשָׁמָה ;]
1. **a blowing, blast, wind**: [[Act.2.2|Act.2:2]]
2. **a breathing, breath**: [[Act.17.25|Act.17:25]] ([[Gen.2.7|Gen.2:7]], al.).†
(AS)

G4195.def:
**Πόντος**, -ου, ὁ
**Pontus, a region of Asia Minor, bordering on the πόντος Εὔξεινος**: [[Act.2.9|Act.2:9]], [[1Pe.1.1|1Pe.1:1]].†
(AS)

G4199.def:
**πορθέω ** collat. form (in cl. chiefly poët.) of πέρθω,
[in LXX: [[4Ma.4.23|4Ma.4:23]] [[4Mac.11.4|4Mac 11:4]] * ;]
**to destroy, ravage**: [[Act.9.21|Act.9:21]], [[Gal.1.13, 23|Gal.1:13, 23]].†
(AS)

G4173.def:
**πολιτάρχης**, -ου, ὁ
= πολίαρχος (Pind., Eur.),
**the ruler of a city, a politarch**: [[Act.17.6|Act.17:6]], 8 (see MM, xx).†
(AS)

G4163.def:
**ποιητής**, -οῦ ὁ
(ποιέω), [in LXX: [[1Ma.2.67|1Ma.2:67]] * ;]
in cl.,
1. a maker, author.
2. Esp., a poet: [[Act.17.28|Act.17:28]] Later,
3. **a doer**: τ. νόμου, [[Rom.2.13|Rom.2:13]], [[Jas.4.11|Jas.4:11]] (1Mac, l.with); ἔργου, [[Jas.1.25|Jas.1:25]] λόγου, ib. [[Jas.1.22-23|Jas.1:22-23]]†
(AS)

G4193.def: **from Pontus, Pontic **, (Iliad by Homer) δένδρεον, probably, **the bird-cherry **, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G4144.def:
**πλόος**, πλούς genitive, -όου, -oῦ (and in late writers also πλοός, like νοός from νοῦς), ὁ
(πλέω), [in LXX: [[Wis.14.1|Wis.14:1]] * ;]
**a voyage**: [[Act.21.7; 27.9-10|Act.21:7 27:9-10]].†
(AS)

G4174.def:
**πολιτεία**, -ας, ἡ
(πολιτεύω), [in LXX: [[2Ma.4.11|2Ma.4:11]] [[2Mac.6.23|2Mac 6:23]] [[2Mac.8.17|2Mac 8:17]] [[2Mac.13.14|2Mac 13:14]], [[3Ma.3.21|3Ma.3:21]] [[3Mac.3.23|3Mac 3:23]], [[4Ma.3.20|4Ma.3:20]] [[4Mac.8.7|4Mac 8:7]] [[4Mac.17.9|4Mac 17:9]] * ;]
1. **citizenship**: [[Act.22.28|Act.22:28]] (3 Mac, ll. with, Hdt., Xen., a1.).
2. government, administration (Aristoph., Dem., al.).
3. **a commonwealth**: [[Eph.2.12|Eph.2:12]]†
(AS)

G4176.def:
**πολιτεύω ** more frequently as depon., -ομαι, and so in LXX and NT
(πολίτης), [in LXX: [[Est.8.13|Est.8:13]], [[2Ma.6.1|2Ma.6:1]] [[2Mac.11.25|2Mac 11:25]], [[3Ma.3.4|3Ma.3:4]] [[3Mac.3.1-30|3Mac 3:1-30]]; [[4Ma.4.1-26|4Ma.4:1-26]] * ;]
**to be a citizen, live as a citizen**: metaphorically, of conduct as based on heavenly citizenship, [[Act.23.1|Act.23:1]], [[Php.1.27|Php.1:27]].†
(AS)

G4161.def:
**ποίημα**, -τος, τό
(ποιέω), [in LXX chiefly for מַעֲשֶׂה (frequently in Ec) ;]
**that which is made or done, a work**: [[Rom.1.20|Rom.1:20]], [[Eph.2.10|Eph.2:10]].†
(AS)

G4121.def:
**πλεονάζω**
(πλέον), [in LXX for עֲדַף, רָבָה, etc. ;]
I. Intrans.
1. **Of persons**;
(a) **to abound in **(Arist.);
(b) **to superabound**: [[2Co.8.15|2Co.8:15]] (LXX).
2. **Of things, to abound, superabound**: [[Rom.5.20; 6.1|Rom.5:20 6:1]], [[2Co.4.15|2Co.4:15]], [[Php.4.17|Php.4:17]], [[2Th.1.3|2Th.1:3]], [[2Pe.1.8|2Pe.1:8]].
II. Trans. ([[Num.26.54|Num.26:54]], [[Psa.71.21|Psa.71:21]]; not cl, see Lft., _Notes_, 48 f.), **to make to abound**: [[1Th.3.12|1Th.3:12]] (cf. ὑπερ-πλεονάζω).†
_SYN._: περισσεύω, q.v (AS)

G4110.def:
**πλάσμα**, -τος, τό
(πλάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for יֵצֶר ;]
**that which is moulded or formed **: [[Rom.9.20|Rom.9:20]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G4111.def:
**πλάσσω **
[in LXX chiefly for יָצַר ;]
**to form, mould**: [[Rom.9.26|Rom.9:26]] (LXX), [[1Ti.2.13|1Ti.2:13]]†
(AS)

G4148.def:
**πλουτίζω**
(πλοῦτος), [in LXX chiefly for עָשַׁר hi. ;]
**to make rich, enrich**: with accusative of person(s), pass., [[2Co.9.11|2Co.9:11]] Metaphorical, of spiritual riches, with accusative: of person(s), [[2Co.6.10|2Co.6:10]] before ἐν, pass., [[1Co.1.5|1Co.1:5]]†
(AS)

G4153.def:
**πνευματικῶς **
_adv._ (πνεῦμα),
**spiritually**;
(a) **by the aid of the Holy Spirit**: [[1Co.2.13|1Co.2:13]] (WH, mg.), [[1Co.2.14|1Co.2:14]]
(b) **in a spiritual sense **: [[Rev.11.8|Rev.11:8]]†
(AS)

G4123.def:
**πλεονέκτης**, -ου, ὁ
(πλέον, ἔχω), [in LXX: [[Sir.14.9|Sir.14:9]] * ;]
= ὁ θέλων πλέον ἔχειν (see MM, xx),
**one desirous of having more, covetous**: [[1Co.5.10-11; 6.10|1Co.5:10-11 6:10]] [[Eph.5.5|Eph.5:5]].†
(AS)

G4188.def:
**πόμα**, -τος, τό
(πίνω),
late form of Att.. πῶμα,
[in LXX.: [[Psa.102.9|Psa.102:9]] (שִׁקּוּי), al. 4 * ;]
**drink**: [[1Co.10.4|1Co.10:4]], [[Heb.9.10|Heb.9:10]].†
(AS)

G4122.def:
**πλεονεκτέω**, -ῶ
(πλεονέκτης, which see), [in LXX: [[Hab.2.9|Hab.2:9]], [[Ezk.22.27|Eze.22:27]] (בָּצַע), [[Jdg.4.11|Jdg.4:11]] B* ;]
1. intrans., to have more, to have an advantage (cl., with genitive of person(s)).
2. Trans., in late writers (see M, _Pr._, 65), **to over­reach, defraud**: with accusative of person(s), [[2Co.7.2; 12.17-18|2Co.7:2 12:17-18]]; ἐν τ. πράγματιι, [[1Th.4.6|1Th.4:6]] (see M, _Th._, in l); pass., [[2Co.2.11|2Co.2:11]] (as also in cl.; see LS, see word).†
(AS)

G4109.def:
**πλάξ**, -ακός, ἡ
[in LXX for לוּחַ ;]
anything flat and broad.
1. a plain (poët.).
2. In late writers (Luc., al.), **a flat stone, a tablet**: [[2Co.3.3|2Co.3:3]], [[Heb.9.4|Heb.9:4]].†
(AS)

G4182.def:
**πολυ-ποίκιλος**, -ον
1. much variegated, of greatly differing colours (Eur.).
2. **manifold**: [[Eph.3.10|Eph.3:10]]†
(AS)

G4114.def:
**πλάτος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for רֹחַב ;]
**breadth**: [[Eph.3.18|Eph.3:18]], [[Rev.21.16|Rev.21:16]]; τ. π. τῆς γῆς ([[Hab.1.6|Hab.1:6]], מֶרְחָב), [[Rev.20.9|Rev.20:9]]†
(AS)

G4175.def:
**πολίτευμα**, -τος, τό
(πολιτεύω), [in LXX: [[2Ma.12.7|2Ma.12:7]] * ;]
1. an act of administration.
2. a form of government.
3. = πολιτεία,
(a) **citizenship **: [[Php.3.20|Php.3:20]] (R, txt.);
(b) **community, commonwealth **: Phi, l.with (R, mg.; for exx, see MM, xx).†
(AS)

G4136.def:
**πληροφορία**, -ας, ἡ
(πληροφορέω),
**full assurance, confidence**: [[1Th.1.5|1Th.1:5]] τ. συνέσεως, [[Col.2.2|Col.2:2]] τ. ἐλπίδος, [[Heb.6.11|Heb.6:11]] πίστεως, [[Heb.10.22|Heb.10:22]] (cf. Lft. on Col., l.with; M, _Th._, 9).†
(AS)

G4140.def:
**πλησμονή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(πίμπλημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂבֵעַ and cognate forms ;]
**a filling up, satiety**: πρὸς π. σαρκός (RV, against the indulgence of the flesh; but _ICC_, in l, for the full satisfaction of the flesh, _op. cit._, 276 ff.), [[Col.2.23|Col.2:23]]†
(AS)

G4192.def:
**πόνος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for עָמָל, etc. ;]
1. **labour, toil**: [[Col.4.13|Col.4:13]]
2. **The consequence of toil, distress, suffering, pain **(Xen., al., LXX): [[Rev.16.10-11; 21.4|Rev.16:10-11 21:4]].†
_SYN._: see: κόπος (AS)

G4117.def:
**πλέγμα**, -τος, τό
(πλέκω), [in Aq., _Th._: [[Isa.28.5|Isa.28:5]] * ;]
**what is woven or twisted **(as basket-work, nets, etc.); a braiding (sc. τριχῶν, cf. [[1Pe.3.3|1Pe.3:3]]) : pl., [[1Ti.2.9|1Ti.2:9]]†
(AS)

G4131.def:
**πλήκτης**, -ου, ὁ
(πλήσσω), [in Sm.: [[Psa.35.15|Psa.35:15]] * ;]
**a striker, brawler**: [[1Ti.3.3|1Ti.3:3]], [[Tit.1.7|Tit.1:7]] (Arist., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4104.def:
**πιστόω**, -ῶ
(πιστός), [in LXX chiefly for אָמֵן ni. ;]
to make trustworthy (Thuc., [[1Ki.1.36|3Ki.1:36]]), hence, to establish ([[1Ch.17.14|1Ch.17:14]]). Pass. and mid., **to be assured of**: with accusative of thing(s), [[2Ti.3.14|2Ti.3:14]]†
(AS)

G4181.def:
**πολυμερῶς **
_adv._ (πολύς, μέρος),
**in many parts or portions**: [[Heb.1.1|Heb.1:1]] (Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4187.def:
**πολυτρόπως **
_adv._ (πολύτροπος, 1. much turning. 2. manifold ), [in LXX: [[4Ma.3.21|4Ma.3:21]] A * ;]
